title: Add internal feature flag + RBAC gating for Unit Economics dashboard
author: Kaitlyn Nguyen
release_notes: Internal-only: Unit Economics dashboard is now gated behind a server-side feature flag and RBAC permission; access is deny-by-default and audited.
description: Context: The new internal Unit Economics dashboard surfaces sensitive cost data (blended $/1M output tokens, drilldowns by model/region/tier). We need to ensure access is restricted to a small internal allowlist initially and that all access is auditable for Finance and Security sign-off. This PR adds (1) a server-side feature flag gate and (2) RBAC policy updates + enforcement in the Console backend so that the Unit Economics endpoints and UI route are not reachable unless explicitly granted. Changes: - Feature flag: add `console.internal_unit_economics_dashboard` (server-side, env-scoped). Default OFF in all environments; can be enabled in prod only for the internal allowlist group. - RBAC: introduce permission `console:unit_economics:read` and require it for all unit economics API endpoints + the console route loader. - Enforcement points: apply gating at the HTTP router layer and again at the service layer (defense-in-depth) so future endpoints don’t accidentally bypass checks. - Audit logging: emit an audit event on successful access and on denied access (includes actor, org, reason: missing_flag vs missing_permission). - Admin tooling: add a small helper to map the initial allowlist group to the permission for dogfood rollout. Notes: - The UI still renders behind the flag, but if the backend gate denies access, the page shows the standard “Permission denied” state (UI work in PR-19378). - This intentionally does not add any customer-level permissions; v1 is internal-only (no customer exposure). Testing: unit tests cover flag off -> 404/403 behavior, permission missing -> 403, both enabled -> success, and audit event emission. Follow-ups: - Once Finance signs off on metric definitions, we can expand the allowlist and/or move to role-based groups (Finance, Platform Eng, SRE) instead of named individuals. - Consider adding a “redacted mode” for broader internal visibility if needed (out of v1 scope).
commits: authz: add console:unit_economics:read permission + policy wiring
console: gate unit economics routes behind internal feature flag
audit: add audit events for unit economics access/denies
tests: add RBAC/flag coverage for unit economics endpoints
docs: update internal access notes + link to INT-1042
review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security): Can we make this deny-by-default even if the UI route is hit directly? I’d prefer the backend returns 404 (not found) when the feature flag is off to avoid hinting the endpoint exists. Also want an audit event for denied attempts (flag off / permission missing) so we can track accidental exposure attempts. Kaitlyn Nguyen (Author): Updated. Router now returns 404 when flag is off; permission missing still 403. Added audit events for both denied cases with a `deny_reason` field. Chloe Martin: Please ensure we’re checking both flag and permission on every endpoint, not just the top-level route. We’ve had regressions where new drilldown endpoints forgot authz. Kaitlyn Nguyen (Author): Added `requireUnitEconAccess()` helper and applied to all unit economics routes; also added a service-layer assertion so even if a route forgets the middleware, it fails closed. Added a test that enumerates the router paths and validates the middleware is attached. Sean Gallagher (SRE): The audit log volume might be high if people bookmark the page; make sure denied access is sampled or at least not going to page oncall. Kaitlyn Nguyen (Author): Denied audit events are logged at INFO (not alerting) and rate-limited per actor/org (60/min). Successful access logs at INFO once per session (24h) to reduce noise. Allison Grant: Can we include the feature flag state in the response headers for debugging? Kaitlyn Nguyen (Author): Added `x-rw-unit-econ-flag: on|off` and `x-rw-unit-econ-permission: allowed|denied` headers only for internal staff requests (employee SSO), not for external traffic. Marcus Lin: Approved with the header restriction; thanks. Chloe Martin: Approved. Dylan Brooks: Looks good; aligns with rollout plan. Merge it once CI is green.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into `main` after approvals from Security + Console Eng; rollout behind flag remains OFF by default. Enabling in prod will be done via internal change management once Finance confirms allowlist (tracked in PM-487).
